spans.s: नृ—कलेवर m. a human body, dead body, Kathās.
नृ—कल्प m. N. of a man (cf. नार्कल्पि).
नृ—कार m. manly deed, heroism, Subh.
नृ—कुक्कुर m. ‘man-dog’, a dog of a man, Rājat.
नृ—कुल-देवा f. N. of a woman, Bhadrab.
नृ—केसरि (NṛsUp.) and नृ—केस˚रिन् (Cat.), m. ‘man-lion’, Viṣṇu in his 4th Avatāra (written also -केश्˚).
